name: pincher-mcp-core-lean
description: The schema-diet treatment arm on the SCALED messy corpus: a master-built pincher binary (/tmp/pincher-scale-bin — schema diet postdates the v1.5.0 release) over stdio with PINCHER_TOOLSET=core + PINCHER_SCHEMA_STYLE=lean injected via the MCP config env block, dedicated data dir (/tmp/loopbench-scale-data-cl). Pre-build (`go build -o /tmp/pincher-scale-bin ./cmd/pinch`) and pre-index (`/tmp/pincher-scale-bin index /tmp/messy-scale-repo --data-dir /tmp/loopbench-scale-data-cl`) first. Same coaching/tool policy as the other pincher-mcp arms.
